content: Verified directly: three 0.185.1 package.json has no types field and ships no d.ts files (files list: build, examples/jsm, LICENSE, package.json, README.md, src). The types-three package is still required for TypeScript. It is generated by the actively-maintained three-types slash three-ts-types project and published to npm, kept in sync per Three.js revision, not deprecated or abandoned despite some search results implying three ships its own types.
